20247.long_desc:
The 35-inch Arcooda 4x3 ratio LCD Monitor with integrated speakers is a premium large-format display designed for retro gaming, arcade cabinets, and digital art installations. Supporting 15kHz to 1440x1080 video signals, this monitor delivers authentic arcade visuals while offering modern connectivity and multimedia functionality. Built-In Speakers for Complete Audio-Visual Setup This upgraded model includes integrated stereo speakers, making it ideal for digital signage, art displays, and interactive exhibits. The built-in audio removes the need for external speakers, simplifying installation and reducing clutter. Ideal Monitor for Digital Art & Exhibition Displays With its 4x3 aspect ratio and 1440x1080 resolution, this 35-inch display provides a canvas-like viewing experience perfect for:
  • Digital artwork and pixel art
  • Gallery and museum installations
  • Portrait and retro-format content
  • Creative studio environments
    • The full viewing angles and vibrant colour reproduction ensure consistent image quality in public or collaborative spaces. True Arcade Compatibility with Modern Performance Engineered for arcade enthusiasts, this LCD monitor supports:
  • Native 15kHz / 24kHz / 31kHz compatibility
  • Over 160+ supported resolutions and modes
  • Ultra-low 1.5ms input lag for responsive gameplay
  • Almost all JAMMA arcade game boards on plug and play basis, with true auto picture correction
    • It’s the perfect CRT monitor replacement for arcade machines while also functioning as a high-quality modern display. Flexible Connectivity & Installation Choose from VGA, DVI, HDMI and DisplayPort inputs, as well as RGB input via the RGB board (optional). Supports DDC/CI and control your inputs and monitor settings via your PC. The monitor also supports VESA mounting (100x100mm M6, 200x200mm M8), making it suitable for arcade cabinets, wall-mounted displays, or studio setups. The monitor also includes 4 mounting brackets as standard for your custom installation. Key Features
  • 35” 4x3 aspect ratio display – ideal for retro content and artistic presentation
  • Integrated speakers – all-in-one audio-visual solution
  • Up to 1440×1080 resolution with 160+ supported modes including 15khz/240p
  • Ultra-low 1.5ms display lag for responsive performance
  • Full viewing angles & vibrant colour reproduction
  • Versatile inputs: HDMI, DisplayPort, VGA, DVI
  • VESA mounting & flexible installation options
  • 700nits high brightness panel - great option for public displays
  • Remote control and/or breakout monitor adjustment board
    • Best Uses
  • Digital artists & creative studio display
  • Exhibition and gallery installations
  • Retro gaming enthusiasts
  • Interactive installations and media walls
  • Arcade cabinet replacement monitor and custom builds
    • Whether you're presenting interactive artwork, running multimedia exhibits, or showcasing video content, the integrated audio eliminates the need for external speakers and offers a complete audio-visual solution.
